# Emergency Electric and Plumbing Service – Plumbing Division

> Plumber service for homes and businesses in Uttara, Bashundhara and north Dhaka, Bangladesh. Book on WhatsApp 01609-993537. Open 24 hours, every day. The company's Electrical Division is at https://www.electricservicebd.com.

## Quick facts
- Business: Emergency Electric and Plumbing Service (ইমার্জেন্সি ইলেকট্রিক এন্ড প্লাম্বিং সার্ভিস) – Plumbing Division
- Phone / WhatsApp: 01609-993537 (international +8801609993537)
- Hours: Open 24 hours, every day
- Base: Uttara, Dhaka, Bangladesh
- Payment: after the job, by Cash, bKash, Nagad, NPSB bank transfer
- Languages: Bangla and English
- How to order: WhatsApp message (one tap), a short order form (https://www.plumbingservicebd.com/order/) or a phone call. Every order gets an Order ID like ES-301026-1.

## Services
- [Plumbing Checkup & Inspection](https://www.plumbingservicebd.com/services/plumbing-checkup-inspection/): A full check of your flat's taps, pipes, commodes, drains, water pressure and hidden leaks, with a written list of problems.
- [Geyser Installation & Water Line Connection](https://www.plumbingservicebd.com/services/geyser-installation/): Safe geyser installation with strong wall mounting, hot and cold water lines, safety valve and connection to shower and basin.
- [Water Leakage Detection and Repair](https://www.plumbingservicebd.com/services/water-leakage-detection-repair/): We find hidden leaks behind walls, under floors and in ceilings (seepage from the flat above) and repair them with minimal breaking.
- [Water Tap Installation & Replacement](https://www.plumbingservicebd.com/services/water-tap-installation/): New and replacement taps for basin, kitchen, bathroom and balcony — leak-free fitting with proper thread seal.
- [Commode Installation & Repair](https://www.plumbingservicebd.com/services/commode-installation-repair/): Installation of floor-mounted and wall-hung commodes, flush tank repair, seat replacement and fixing leaks at the base.
- [Drain / Pipe Blockage Removal](https://www.plumbingservicebd.com/services/drain-blockage-removal/): Clearing blocked floor traps, commode lines, bathroom drains and main sewer pipes with proper tools — no harsh chemicals.
- [Basin Installation & Repair](https://www.plumbingservicebd.com/services/basin-installation-repair/): Wall-hung, pedestal and counter basin installation, with tap, waste pipe and bottle trap — plus fixing loose or leaking basins.
- [Shower Installation & Repair](https://www.plumbingservicebd.com/services/shower-installation-repair/): Overhead, hand and rain shower installation, mixer connection and repair of low pressure or leaking showers.
- [Mixer & Bib Cock Installation](https://www.plumbingservicebd.com/services/mixer-bib-cock-installation/): Installation and replacement of wall mixers, basin mixers, bib cocks and two-way taps with leak-free connections.
- [Water Pipe Leakage Repair](https://www.plumbingservicebd.com/services/water-pipe-leakage-repair/): Fast repair of visible pipe leaks, burst pipes, leaking joints and valves — under sinks, in bathrooms, on rooftops and in pump rooms.
- [Basin & Sink Drain Cleaning](https://www.plumbingservicebd.com/services/basin-sink-drain-cleaning/): Slow or blocked basin and kitchen sink? We clean the trap and waste pipe, remove grease and hair build-up, and fix leaks under the sink.
- [Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing](https://www.plumbingservicebd.com/services/bathroom-kitchen-plumbing/): Complete bathroom and kitchen plumbing — new fittings, sink and basin lines, floor traps, renovations and leak repairs.
- [New Water Line Installation & Repair](https://www.plumbingservicebd.com/services/water-line-installation-repair/): New water lines with quality PPR or uPVC pipes for flats, kitchens, bathrooms and rooftops, plus repair of old and rusted lines.
- [Water Pump Installation & Connection](https://www.plumbingservicebd.com/services/water-pump-installation/): Water pump installation and replacement for houses and buildings — suction and delivery lines, foot valve, auto switch and tank connection.
- [Angle Valve Installation](https://www.plumbingservicebd.com/services/angle-valve-installation/): Angle valve fitting and replacement for basins, commodes, geysers and kitchen sinks, so each fixture can be shut off separately.
- [Gas Stove Installation & Repair](https://www.plumbingservicebd.com/services/gas-stove-installation-repair/): Gas stove installation, burner and knob repair, gas pipe and regulator connection, and leak checks for line gas and cylinders.
- [Washing Machine Installation](https://www.plumbingservicebd.com/services/washing-machine-installation/): Washing machine installation with inlet tap, hose, drain connection and leveling — for front-load and top-load machines.
- [Water Purifier Installation & Servicing](https://www.plumbingservicebd.com/services/water-purifier-installation-servicing/): RO and filter-type water purifier installation, filter replacement and servicing for clean drinking water at home and office.
- [Bathroom Accessories Installation (Towel Rack & Soap Holder)](https://www.plumbingservicebd.com/services/bathroom-accessories-installation/): Installation of towel racks, soap holders, tissue holders, shelves, hooks and grab bars — neatly fitted on tiles without cracks.
- [Wall Mirror Installation](https://www.plumbingservicebd.com/services/wall-mirror-installation/): Bathroom and dressing mirror installation with safe brackets or clips, at the right height above the basin.
- [Minor Home Maintenance & Repair](https://www.plumbingservicebd.com/services/minor-home-maintenance-repair/): One visit for the small jobs list — dripping taps, loose fittings, door issues, small leaks and odd jobs around the flat.
- [Commercial Plumbing Check-up](https://www.plumbingservicebd.com/commercial/commercial-plumbing-checkup/): Plumbing audit for offices, shops, restaurants and buildings: water supply, pumps, tanks, drains, washrooms and leaks, with a prioritised report.
- [Commercial Plumbing Installation & Repair](https://www.plumbingservicebd.com/commercial/commercial-plumbing-installation-repair/): Plumbing for offices, showrooms, restaurants and buildings — washrooms, pantries, kitchen lines, pumps and repairs.
- [Commercial Drainage & Blockage Removal](https://www.plumbingservicebd.com/commercial/commercial-drainage-blockage-removal/): Clearing blocked drains, sewer lines and grease-heavy restaurant kitchen drains for shops, restaurants and buildings.
- [Water Supply Line Installation & Repair](https://www.plumbingservicebd.com/commercial/water-supply-line-installation/): Main water supply lines, riser pipes, overhead and underground tank connections for buildings, with valves for easy maintenance.
- [Shop, Restaurant & Super Shop Maintenance](https://www.plumbingservicebd.com/commercial/shop-restaurant-supershop-maintenance/): Monthly maintenance for shops, restaurants and super shops — plumbing, drains, washrooms and electrical — from one trusted team.

## Frequently asked questions

### Booking and timing

**How do I book an electrician or plumber?**
Three ways: tap "Order now" to send a WhatsApp message, fill in the short order form (work, address, date and time), or call 01609-993537. You don't need an account or an app.

**What is the Order ID in my WhatsApp message?**
Every order gets an ID like ES-301026-1 (service letters, job date, number). Keep it — quote it when you message us about that job, for a follow-up visit or a bill.

**Are you really open 24 hours, including Friday and holidays?**
Yes, we take orders 24 hours a day, every day, including Fridays and government holidays. At night we go first to urgent jobs: no power, sparking, short circuit, water leaking or overflowing. During Eid holidays please message first so we can confirm a time.

**How fast can a technician reach me?**
For urgent jobs in most of Uttara we usually arrive in about 60 minutes. Bashundhara and other areas can take longer depending on traffic. Booked jobs come at the time you choose.

**Can I book for a specific date and time?**
Yes. In the order form pick a day (up to a week ahead) and a 2-hour time slot, or choose Urgent. We confirm the time on WhatsApp.

**Which areas do you cover?**
All sectors of Uttara, all blocks of Bashundhara R/A, and nearby north Dhaka areas such as Uttarkhan, Dakkhinkhan, Diabari and Abdullahpur. The Areas page has the full list. Outside these areas, message us — we often still come.

**Does someone need to be at home?**
Yes, please keep an adult at home (or a contact person at the office or shop) to show us the problem and check the work before we leave.

### Plumbing problems

**Water is leaking into the flat downstairs — what do you do?**
We find the exact source first — bathroom floor, pipe joint, commode or drain — then open only what's needed and fix it. We explain the options before any breaking.

**My water pressure is low or the pump isn't lifting water — can you help?**
Yes. We check the pump (motor), valves, pipes and tank line, then repair or install the right pump. The water pump calculator on this site helps you pick a size.

**My commode, basin or kitchen drain is blocked — can you clear it without damage?**
Yes. We clear blockages with the right tools, without breaking fittings, and tell you what caused it so it doesn't come back.

**Do you install geysers and connect the water line?**
Yes — geyser mounting, hot and cold water line connection and a leak check. Our electricians can also do the separate power line the geyser needs.

**Do you fix leaks without breaking the whole bathroom?**
We first find the exact leak point, then open only what's needed. We explain the options before any breaking.

**Can you replace taps, showers, commodes and basins?**
Yes — we install and replace all bathroom and kitchen fittings, including mixers, angle valves, washing machine and water purifier lines.

### Cost and payment

**Will I know the cost before work starts?**
Yes. We look at the problem (on WhatsApp photos or on site), tell you the cost and agree it with you before starting. Nothing extra is added without asking you first.

**Is there a visit or checkup charge?**
Any electric or plumbing checkup is 350 Tk, and it can be reduced depending on the work. We confirm the amount on WhatsApp before we come.

**Why are there no prices on the website?**
Every job is different — cable length, pipe type, wall, height, parts. Send a photo or short video on WhatsApp and we give you a clear estimate first.

**How do I pay — are bKash, Nagad or bank transfer accepted?**
You pay after the work is completed, by Cash, bKash, Nagad, NPSB bank transfer.

**Do I get a bill or memo?**
Yes, on request we give a memo for home jobs. Offices and companies get a written quotation before work and a bill with the Order ID after.

### Parts, safety and trust

**Do you bring the parts, or should I buy them?**
We bring common parts and can buy anything else nearby. You can also buy your own parts — we'll tell you exactly what to get. We use branded parts and show you the receipt.

**Is there a warranty on your work?**
Parts carry the maker's warranty. If the same problem comes back from our work, message us with your Order ID and we'll come and check it again.

**Are your technicians our own staff? Is it safe to let them in?**
Yes — our own trained team, in company uniform. We send the technician's name and phone number before the visit, and you can call our main number any time to check.

**Can I talk to you in Bangla?**
Of course. Message or call in Bangla or English — whatever is easier for you.

**Do you do both electrical and plumbing work?**
Yes. Emergency Electric and Plumbing Service has an Electrical Division (electricservicebd.com) and a Plumbing Division (plumbingservicebd.com), plus AC and home services. One message, one team.

### Electrical problems

**I smell burning or see sparks — what should I do?**
Switch off the main breaker (MCB) at once, keep away from water and don't touch the burnt switch or wire. Then tap Order now and mark it Urgent, or call us — this is a priority job.

**Why does my breaker (MCB) keep tripping?**
Usually an overloaded line (AC, geyser or iron on the same circuit), a short circuit, a loose connection or moisture. We find the cause and fix it — never just fit a bigger breaker.

**What size IPS do I need for load shedding?**
It depends on the fans, lights, router and TV you want to run and for how long. Use the IPS load calculator on this site, or send us the list on WhatsApp and we'll suggest a size.

**There's a problem with the electricity meter or the line outside — can you fix it?**
The meter and the line up to it belong to the electricity company (DESCO in Uttara and Bashundhara) — contact them for those. We handle everything after the meter: the main board, breakers, wiring, sockets and appliances.

**Do you do full wiring for a new flat or an old building?**
Yes. We plan the load, use branded cables of the right size, separate lines for AC and geyser, proper earthing and a labelled distribution board.

**Are your electricians trained for safe work?**
Yes. The team is led by an electrical engineer. We switch off and test lines before working, use correctly rated cables and breakers, and check earthing.

### Offices and businesses

**Do you work for offices, shops and companies?**
Yes — offices, shops, restaurants, super shops, clinics, schools and apartment buildings, from one-off repairs to full installations.

**Can you work at night or on Friday so our business isn't disturbed?**
Yes. We regularly work early morning, at night and on weekends so shops and offices keep running.

**Do you offer a monthly maintenance contract?**
Yes. Regular checks of boards, wiring, lighting and plumbing, priority response for faults and a monthly report. See the maintenance contract page or ask for a site survey.

**Do you give a written quotation and bill for companies?**
Yes. After a site survey we send a written quotation with the scope of work, and a bill after the job.
